edits.current: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING NUMERAL: the income-tax withholding ACTUALLY PRACTISED on the beneficiary's work or pension income in the tax year, by payment date (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element vare). For a RESIDENT it is the ET art. 383 table result under Procedure 1 or 2; for a NON-RESIDENT it is the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the gross. Source: every wage type that records withholding actually practised and remitted - the employee income-tax wage type and the separate withholding wage types for terminations, retirees and equity awards. Hypothetical, notional or theoretical amounts are excluded: a tax-equalisation amount enters only to the extent it was actually withheld and declared on Form 350, and the contingent withholding of ET arts. 126-1 and 126-4, which the fund practises on a withdrawal, is never included. Maps to Form 220 casilla 60, likewise the withholding actually practised, and the sum across the population reconciles to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93.
